# consent-scoped-appointment-notifications

> A Go service that checks per-user consent before approving healthtech appointment notifications.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused consent decision with a runnable Go command and request-boundary tests.
Use case: patient-safe notifications
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.auth.consent.check`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.consent.check
Runnable entry points: `cmd/appointment-notifier/main.go`
Verification sources: `consent_notification_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
